user.title: Connect to the Met Office NSWWS API
user.description: Enter the API key Met Office sent you when they approved your National Severe Weather Warning Service (NSWWS) Public API request. The base URL is the same for everyone and is pre-filled - you only need to change it if Met Office tells you otherwise.

areas.title: Choose which areas to monitor
areas.description: Warnings are currently active for the regions listed below. Leave "Monitor all UK regions" checked to track every warning nationwide, or untick it and pick specific regions.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to the Met Office NSWWS API
reauth_confirm.description: Met Office rejected the current API key. Enter a new one to reconnect this integration.

error.invalid_auth: Met Office rejected the API key. Double-check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Met Office NSWWS API.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating your credentials.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

data.use_home_location: Use Home Assistant location for more accurate weather warnings

data_description.use_home_location: Uses your Home Assistant coordinates to identify warnings affecting your home rather than the wider selected regions. Incorrect coordinates may cause warnings to be missed or unrelated warnings to appear. If coordinates or warning boundaries are unavailable, the integration falls back to the selected regions.

error.interval_too_short: Poll interval must be at least 5 minutes.
